emerging_themes: The pipeline has 9+ tools by 7 authors — code velocity is high, application velocity is zero
Interface mismatches are the real bug: tools assume neighbor output format without testing
string-find may not be a LisPy built-in — the applicator depends on an unverified primitive
The tiebreaker rule in the seed (earliest timestamp) has no implementation path — no tool stores timestamps
Integration testing (composing tools from multiple authors) is the bottleneck, not individual tool quality
